command:
set -euo pipefail
cd /tmp
echo "== pymatgen: bulk silicon structure + symmetry + a CIF round-trip =="
# Constructs Si from its space group, then asserts exact structural identities and a
# Structure -> CIF -> Structure round-trip (the decode-statistic move on a crystal-structure
# format). Space group is via SpacegroupAnalyzer, which is spglib-backed -- so it's a
# reference check against the known value (Fd-3m, #227), NOT an independent second engine.
python3 - <<'EOF' > smoke-check.txt || { cat smoke-check.txt; exit 1; }
import sys
from pymatgen.core import Structure, Lattice
from pymatgen.symmetry.analyzer import SpacegroupAnalyzer
fail=[]
def check(l,ok,detail):
    print(f"{l:24s} {detail}")
    if not ok: fail.append(l)
s=Structure.from_spacegroup("Fd-3m", Lattice.cubic(5.43), ["Si"], [[0,0,0]])
check("nsites", len(s)==8, f"{len(s)}  want 8 (conventional diamond cell)")
check("reduced_formula", s.composition.reduced_formula=="Si", f"{s.composition.reduced_formula}  want Si")
check("lattice_a", abs(s.lattice.a-5.43)<1e-6, f"{s.lattice.a:.4f}  want 5.43 (by construction)")
# density is exact from mass/volume, and matches silicon's known ~2.329 g/cm^3 (reference)
check("density", abs(float(s.density)-2.3304)<1e-3, f"{float(s.density):.4f} g/cm^3  want 2.3304 (Si known ~2.329)")
sga=SpacegroupAnalyzer(s, symprec=1e-4)
check("spacegroup", sga.get_space_group_symbol()=="Fd-3m" and sga.get_space_group_number()==227,
      f"{sga.get_space_group_symbol()} (#{sga.get_space_group_number()})  want Fd-3m (#227), reference")
# decode: Structure -> CIF -> Structure recovers sites, formula and lattice
s2=Structure.from_str(s.to(fmt="cif"), fmt="cif")
ok=(len(s2)==len(s) and s2.composition.reduced_formula==s.composition.reduced_formula and abs(s2.lattice.a-s.lattice.a)<1e-6)
check("cif_roundtrip", ok, f"{ok}  want True (sites+formula+lattice recovered)")
if fail: print("FAILED: "+", ".join(fail)); sys.exit(1)
EOF
cat smoke-check.txt; echo "SMOKE CHECK PASSED"
